correctness.rationale: The six cyclic pentad orbits generate 66 distinct blocks and uniquely cover all 330 four-subsets; the 66 free hexads are precisely the block complements. Every nonblock five-set extends uniquely to a free hexad, proving Alexander self-duality with the stated convention. Independent exhaustive enumeration reproduced the nonempty f-vector (11,55,165,330,396,66), 1023 faces, 451 disjoint vertex-pivot Morse pairs, one critical vertex plus 120 four-simplices; a topological sort of all 4301 oriented covering edges visited every face, proving acyclicity. The resulting Morse CW complex has one zero-cell and only 120 four-cells, all with constant attaching maps. The finite exhaustive certificate proves this fixed instance, not an all-Steiner-system theorem.

value.rationale: The unique small Witt design is a canonical exceptionally symmetric finite incidence structure. Its self-Alexander-duality and full integral homotopy classification yield a natural exact invariant useful for studying Steiner-design avoidance complexes and their topology, beyond routine face counting.

final_claim: The block-avoiding complex of the classical S(4,5,11) Witt design is Alexander self-dual on 11 vertices and homotopy equivalent to a wedge of exactly 120 four-spheres.
limitations: Only S(4,5,11), not arbitrary Steiner designs.
Exhaustive finite certificate proves this finite statement; it is not a universal-family result.
